dedupe_keys.name: china cement industry dataset ccid cement plants clinker lines and energy statistics

description: CCID lists cement plants in China with their company, clinker production lines, province, address, kiln size, clinker production capacity and year of operation, and a second file gives thermal and electricity consumption statistics for part of the plants, reported by official departments. It was published by Wu Tongyuan of The University of Hong Kong (version 1.1, June 2023) under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as two Excel files of about 370 KB in total. Coverage is mainland China at plant level. Caveats: plants are located by address, not coordinates, the reference year of the capacities is not stated on the page read, and energy data cover only some plants. For simulation it gives a plant and kiln inventory to model cement supply, energy demand, emissions and disruption of construction material supply chains. Related catalogue records include the Global Cement and Concrete Tracker and the Climate TRACE emissions inventory.
